newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Metals says H1 sales UP.
newsitem.headline: LG Metals says H1 sales UP.

text.p: South Korea's LG Metals Corp, an affiliate of LG Group, said on Wednesday its sales for the first half of this year rose 22 percent to 1.006 trillion won from 827.2 billion won a year ago.

Lee Seung-yu, LG Metal's executive director of strategic planning, said the company also posted a current profit of 28.5 billion won for the first half against a current loss of 7.0 billion a year earlier.
The increase in sales and the profit was mainly due to strong copper prices in the world market, Lee said.
Lee said the company's copper production rose to 132,000 tonnes for the first six months of this year from 122,000 tonnes a year earlier.
LG Metals has South Korea's largest copper smelter and refinery, which also produces gold and silver as by-products.
Lee said its gold output, including production using imported low-grade bullion, rose to 42 tonnes in the first half of this year from 33 tonnes a year ago.
The company's first-half silver output rose to 125 tonnes from 95 tonnes a year earlier, he said.
Lee said LG Metals would invest 1.5 trillion won by 2005 and that the company's sales were expected to reach 5.8 trillion won in 2005.
